relationships.subject: BRD4
relationships.evidence_quote: BRD4 inhibition was able to alleviate inflammatory pain by ameliorating neuronal pyroptosis activated by the NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: JQ1
relationships.evidence_quote: The mechanical and thermal allodynia induced by CFA was predominantly reversed through JQ1 pre-treatment

relationships.subject: JQ1
relationships.evidence_quote: Results showed that the up-regulation of pyroptosis-associated proteins, namely NLRP3, caspase-1-p20, GSDMD-F, GSDMD-N, and mature IL-1β, induced by CFA injection were reduced by JQ1 pre-treatment

relationships.subject: JQ1
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of the NF-κB signaling pathway was significantly reduced by JQ1 pre-treatment through inhibition of p65 phosphorylation

relationships.subject: BRD4
relationships.evidence_quote: Further, relevant alterations of the phosphorylation p65 induced by LPS stimulation were abolished by BRD4 knockdown, thus inhibiting activation of the NF-κB signaling pathway

relationships.subject: BRD4
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 inflammasome activation and the cleavage of caspase-1 and GSDMD, which were induced by LPS and ATP stimulation, were markedly alleviated in HT22 cells with BRD4 knockdown

relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: GSDMD is cleaved by caspase-1-p20 to become GSDMD-N, causing the formation of membrane pore

key_findings: CFA raised spinal neuronal BRD4 and NLRP3/caspase-1/GSDMD pyroptosis proteins; JQ1 reduced them and relieved pain.
BRD4 knockdown or JQ1 suppressed p65 phosphorylation and pyroptosis in HT22 cells.
